title: 地下管線探地雷達探測
summary: 本課聚焦校準雷達波速與定位誤差並保留地下管線判讀的不確定性。十個單元依序辨識作用機制、量化假設、驗證程序與故障徵兆，讓學徒追蹤從原始資料到工程判斷的每一環。每個算例都帶單位與限制，不把局部成功或單一比值當成完整系統合格。交接須保留基準、異常與權責工程師核准的條件。
summaryEn: This course focuses on calibrate radar velocity and location error while retaining buried utility interpretation uncertainty. Ten units connect mechanisms, numerical assumptions, verification procedures and failure symptoms so apprentices can trace each inference from evidence to judgment. Every example includes units and limitations; one successful observation or ratio does not establish system acceptance. Handover retains datums, anomalies and conditions approved by the responsible engineer.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「介電常數與波速」與「雙程時間換深度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Permittivity and wave speed" and "Two way time to depth": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 介電常數與波速：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Permittivity and wave speed: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「介電常數與波速」如何影響地下管線探地雷達探測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Permittivity and wave speed” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ground-penetrating radar for buried utilities”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 地中電磁波速度隨有效介電常數改變，含水率與填土差異因此影響深度換算。低損耗、非磁性近似讓公式容易理解，強導電土層則需考慮衰減與頻散而不能照套。取真空波速c=0.3m/ns、相對介電常數εr=9，v=c/√εr=0.100m/ns；這是均質低損耗假設，並非所有土層固定波速。若沿用乾燥地面的波速處理濕區，深度可能系統性偏大；圖面看似連續但誤差同向累積，後續開挖判斷會錯估管線上方的保護土層。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「介電常數與波速」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Electromagnetic speed varies with effective permittivity, making moisture and fill variation important to depth conversion. A low-loss, nonmagnetic approximation simplifies the relation; conductive ground requires attention to attenuation and dispersion before applying it. With c=0.3m/ns and relative permittivity εr=9, v=c/√εr=0.100m/ns. This assumes homogeneous low-loss ground, not a universal soil velocity. Applying dry-ground velocity in wet material can systematically overestimate depth. A visually continuous map may accumulate consistent error and misrepresent the cover protecting a utility during later excavation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Permittivity and wave speed” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：取真空波速c=0.3m/ns、相對介電常數εr=9，v=c/√εr=0.100m/ns；這是均質低損耗假設，並非所有土層固定波速。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With c=0.3m/ns and relative permittivity εr=9, v=c/√εr=0.100m/ns.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要介電常數與波速符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for permittivity and wave speed removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「介電常數與波速」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Permittivity and wave speed”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 介電常數與波速
knowledge.text: 地中電磁波速度隨有效介電常數改變，含水率與填土差異因此影響深度換算。低損耗、非磁性近似讓公式容易理解，強導電土層則需考慮衰減與頻散而不能照套。
knowledge.textEn: Electromagnetic speed varies with effective permittivity, making moisture and fill variation important to depth conversion. A low-loss, nonmagnetic approximation simplifies the relation; conductive ground requires attention to attenuation and dispersion before applying it.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要介電常數與波速符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for permittivity and wave speed removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「地下管線探地雷達探測」的「介電常數與波速：機制與系統路徑」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出地層、地下水、開挖邊界與支撐的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「地下水與沉陷觀測室」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與地質假設、監測位置、時間順序及基準點版本的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Permittivity and wave speed: mechanism and system paths” in “Ground-penetrating radar for buried utilities”. Draw the ground, groundwater, excavation boundary and support interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Groundwater and settlement observatory” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for ground assumptions, monitoring locations, time order and benchmark version, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「介電常數與波速」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Permittivity and wave speed" is correct?
options: 只要介電常數與波速符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
地中電磁波速度隨有效介電常數改變，含水率與填土差異因此影響深度換算。
只要雙程時間換深度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: A nominal result for permittivity and wave speed removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Electromagnetic speed varies with effective permittivity, making moisture and fill variation important to depth conversion.
A nominal result for two way time to depth removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 地中電磁波速度隨有效介電常數改變，含水率與填土差異因此影響深度換算。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Electromagnetic speed varies with effective permittivity, making moisture and fill variation important to depth conversion. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 介電常數與波速：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Permittivity and wave speed: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「介電常數與波速」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Permittivity and wave speed” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：取真空波速c=0.3m/ns、相對介電常數εr=9，v=c/√εr=0.100m/ns；這是均質低損耗假設，並非所有土層固定波速。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With c=0.3m/ns and relative permittivity εr=9, v=c/√εr=0.100m/ns. This assumes homogeneous low-loss ground, not a universal soil velocity. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以已知深度目標或適用的多偏移距量測校準速度，在不同含水區分別記錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calibrate velocity using a known-depth target or suitable multiple-offset observations, recording wet and dry zones separately.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：取真空波速c=0.3m/ns、相對介電常數εr=9，v=c/√εr=0.100m/ns；這是均質低損耗假設，並非所有土層固定波速。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With c=0.3m/ns and relative permittivity εr=9, v=c/√εr=0.100m/ns. This assumes homogeneous low-loss ground, not a universal soil velocity.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「介電常數與波速」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Permittivity and wave speed", which statement holds?
options: 只要頻率與波長尺度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要介面反射對比符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
教學假設，非現場設定值：取真空波速c=0.3m/ns、相對介電常數εr=9，v=c/√εr=0.100m/ns；這是均質低損耗假設，並非所有土層固定波速。
optionsEn: A nominal result for frequency and wavelength scale removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for interface reflection contrast removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With c=0.3m/ns and relative permittivity εr=9, v=c/√εr=0.100m/ns.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定值：取真空波速c=0.3m/ns、相對介電常數εr=9，v=c/√εr=0.100m/ns；這是均質低損耗假設，並非所有土層固定波速。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With c=0.3m/ns and relative permittivity εr=9, v=c/√εr=0.100m/ns. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 介電常數與波速：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Permittivity and wave speed: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「介電常數與波速」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Permittivity and wave speed” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以已知深度目標或適用的多偏移距量測校準速度，在不同含水區分別記錄。比較換算深度與獨立管線資料，未校準的區段須標明速度假設而非填入精確高程。同時排除以下干擾原因：若沿用乾燥地面的波速處理濕區，深度可能系統性偏大；圖面看似連續但誤差同向累積，後續開挖判斷會錯估管線上方的保護土層。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Calibrate velocity using a known-depth target or suitable multiple-offset observations, recording wet and dry zones separately. Compare depths with independent utility evidence and label uncalibrated sections with their assumed velocity rather than a precise elevation. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Applying dry-ground velocity in wet material can systematically overestimate depth. A visually continuous map may accumulate consistent error and misrepresent the cover protecting a utility during later excavation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接介電常數與波速時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。以已知深度目標或適用的多偏移距量測校準速度，在不同含水區分別記錄。比較換算深度與獨立管線資料，未校準的區段須標明速度假設而非填入精確高程。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over permittivity and wave speed, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Calibrate velocity using a known-depth target or suitable multiple-offset observations, recording wet and dry zones separately. Compare depths with independent utility evidence and label uncalibrated sections with their assumed velocity rather than a precise elevation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若沿用乾燥地面的波速處理濕區，深度可能系統性偏大；圖面看似連續但誤差同向累積，後續開挖判斷會錯估管線上方的保護土層。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Applying dry-ground velocity in wet material can systematically overestimate depth. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以已知深度目標或適用的多偏移距量測校準速度，在不同含水區分別記錄。比較換算深度與獨立管線資料，未校準的區段須標明速度假設而非填入精確高程。同時排除以下干擾原因：若沿用乾燥地面的波速處理濕區，深度可能系統性偏大；圖面看似連續但誤差同向累積，後續開挖判斷會錯估管線上方的保護土層。
knowledge.textEn: Calibrate velocity using a known-depth target or suitable multiple-offset observations, recording wet and dry zones separately. Compare depths with independent utility evidence and label uncalibrated sections with their assumed velocity rather than a precise elevation. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Applying dry-ground velocity in wet material can systematically overestimate depth. A visually continuous map may accumulate consistent error and misrepresent the cover protecting a utility during later excavation.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接介電常數與波速時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。以已知深度目標或適用的多偏移距量測校準速度，在不同含水區分別記錄。比較換算深度與獨立管線資料，未校準的區段須標明速度假設而非填入精確高程。
knowledge.textEn: When handing over permittivity and wave speed, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Calibrate velocity using a known-depth target or suitable multiple-offset observations, recording wet and dry zones separately. Compare depths with independent utility evidence and label uncalibrated sections with their assumed velocity rather than a precise elevation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「介電常數與波速」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Permittivity and wave speed"?
options: 以已知深度目標或適用的多偏移距量測校準速度，在不同含水區分別記錄。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要速度誤差傳遞符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Calibrate velocity using a known-depth target or suitable multiple-offset observations, recording wet and dry zones separately.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A nominal result for velocity error propagation removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 以已知深度目標或適用的多偏移距量測校準速度，在不同含水區分別記錄。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Calibrate velocity using a known-depth target or suitable multiple-offset observations, recording wet and dry zones separately. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 介電常數與波速：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Permittivity and wave speed: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「介電常數與波速」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Permittivity and wave speed” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若沿用乾燥地面的波速處理濕區，深度可能系統性偏大；圖面看似連續但誤差同向累積，後續開挖判斷會錯估管線上方的保護土層。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Applying dry-ground velocity in wet material can systematically overestimate depth. A visually continuous map may accumulate consistent error and misrepresent the cover protecting a utility during later excavation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若沿用乾燥地面的波速處理濕區，深度可能系統性偏大；圖面看似連續但誤差同向累積，後續開挖判斷會錯估管線上方的保護土層。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A visually continuous map may accumulate consistent error and misrepresent the cover protecting a utility during later excavation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要介電常數與波速符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

quiz.explanation: 忘記雙程除二會將深度加倍；若零點漂移卻只修速度，淺目標與深目標可能呈現不同相對誤差，單點校準也會造成錯誤的信心。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Omitting the two-way divisor doubles depth. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
